# Song of Solomon Chapter 3 -- Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-12

This log records all verses in Song of Solomon Chapter 3 where the three translators significantly diverged.

---

## 3:9 — "palanquin" vs. "carriage" vs. "litter"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "A-palanquin [appiryon]" | Hapax legomenon, preserves rare term |
| LOGOS | "a carriage" | Accessible English |
| PNEUMA | "a magnificent carriage" | Adds "magnificent" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "carriage" without added adjectives.

**Status:** All resolved.
